title: Migrate Android build from shell script to Gradle integration
body:
- Replace build-android.sh with swift-android.gradle.kts Gradle integration
- Migrate Gradle files from Groovy to Kotlin DSL (Flutter 3.41 / Gradle 8.14)
- Update swift-java dependency from PADL fork to upstream swiftlang/swift-java
- Rename JavaKit/JavaKitFunction/JavaKitJar products to SwiftJava
- Replace import JavaKit/JavaRuntime with import SwiftJava
- Rename CustomJavaClassLoader to AnyJavaObjectWithCustomClassLoader
- Use upstream SwiftJava ByteBuffer instead of locally-generated JavaNIOByteBuffer
- Fix classPath -> classpath in swift-java.config
- Make SwiftHeapObjectHolder.java public for SwiftJavaPlugin visibility
- Add nonisolated(unsafe) for Swift 6 strict concurrency on JNI globals
- Fix @FlutterPlatformThreadActor on Task closures for Swift 6.3
- Add AndroidLooper import for UIThreadActor in FlutterBinaryMessenger
- Split ChannelManager init/configureHandlers for actor isolation
- Use UIThreadActor.assumeIsolated in Android initChannelManager
- Update AndroidLooper dependency to 0.0.2 (adds assumeIsolated)
- Bundle Swift runtime .so files in APK from swift-resources directory
